query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  gallon_number, 
  liters_purchased/100.0 as liters,
  amount_paid/100.0 as amount,
  notes,
  DATE_FORMAT(purchased_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as purchased_at,
  DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as created_at
FROM fuel_purchases 
WHERE gallon_number = 1
ORDER BY created_at ASC
